canonical_vm.role: Fresh canonical mncs-vm admission and execution runtime

isolated_emitter_transport_probe.role: Isolated host transport probe for large-project selected-callable native emitter execution (kept strictly separate from locked Stage-0 oracle and canonical mncs-vm)

first_disappearance_point.mechanism: Single shared `iterate i up_to 1024` cursor walked `unit.fns` first and only transitioned to `unit.records` (`phase = 1`) when `fns` reached `FnDeclList.FNil`. When `len(unit.fns) >= 1024`, all 1,024 iterations were consumed by functions, never inspecting `unit.records` or `unit.enums`.

step2_fix_collection_algorithm_in_mncs.chunking_strategy: 64 outer chunks of 1024 inner steps (`64 * 1024 = 65,536`) with immediate early exit on list exhaustion (`FnDeclList.FNil`, `RecordDeclList.RNil`, `EnumDeclList.ENil`, `NominalTypeSpanList.NTSNil`, `NominalTypeIdentityList.NTINil`, `NominalReferenceList.NRNil`), matching `collect_call_walk` and `bind_local_callable_identities`.
preserved_invariants: Qualified nominal identity (`dot_pos > start` for `type_kind == 6` and pattern dots)
Exact source byte spans (`start`, `end`, `dot`) and deterministic declaration-order traversal (`fns -> records -> enums`)
Canonical qualified record field identity expansion (`type_kind == 6`) in `record_field_type_identity` + 2-pass `resolve_project_nominal_modules`, matching Stage-0 `canonical_value_type`

Compact `VmIdentityRef` (`VINone` / `VISome` / `VIIndex`) indexing `record_types` and `finite_types` in `vm_emit.mncs` so `VmType` shrinks 58x and `VmInstruction` shrinks 52x inside the 1 GiB Cranelift canonical arena
Bounded source-span re-parse (`end` instead of `total`) across all 6 SSA expression source validators in `src/compiler/ssa.mncs`
